candidate.title: Return a stable conflict response for duplicate session creation
candidate.whatToBuild: A duplicate create-session request returns the existing session identity without creating another session.
candidate.primaryVerification: API integration scenario for two create requests with the same idempotency key.
acceptanceCriteria: The first request creates one session.
The second request returns the same session identity.
The second response reports that the session already existed.
A different idempotency key creates a different session.

candidate.title: Implement failure recovery and operator controls
candidate.whatToBuild: Add failed transactions, retry, session recovery, rerun, concurrency limits, audit views, Compose setup, and Playwright coverage.
candidate.primaryVerification: API, state-machine, UI, Compose, and Playwright suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Operators can inspect recovery in the UI.
Operators can retry from the UI.

candidate.title: Archive completed run evidence
candidate.whatToBuild: Archive evidence after a run completes.
unresolvedDecisions: The retention period has no owner or selected value.
The storage system of record has not been chosen.

candidate.title: Run the isolated production-credential canary
candidate.whatToBuild: An authorized operator completes the isolated canary and records its result and cleanup evidence.
candidate.primaryVerification: Human-run canary in the isolated tenant using credentials intentionally unavailable to agents.
acceptanceCriteria: The operator records the isolated tenant identity before execution.
The canary reaches the expected terminal state.
The operator records the observed result.
Cleanup evidence confirms that the canary resources were removed.
decisionSources: Approved canary runbook and named credential owner
